thread:
Anya: Quick sync — Q3 Private deploy prioritization. Two major customer asks: FinServCo needs VPC control-plane features (per-tenant routing, audit streaming); PharmaCorp wants on-prem/offline installer and air-gap support. We can't deliver full scope for both. Thoughts?

Sam: FinServCo is high upside (>$1M ARR run rate if we hit procurement). Timeline ~6-9m. +1 for prioritizing control-plane.

Mike: Control plane is reusable for Dedicated too. Packaging is heavy on peri-customer engineering.

Lisa: Packaging increases support burden; also lots of distro/driver edge cases. Control-plane gives us product leverage and security story.

Nina: Eng capacity is tight — runtime perf work + infra. Concerned about extending private GA if we parallelize too much.

Andrew: Proposal: sequence work. Milestone 1 (control-plane MVP by Q3 end): policy-based tenant routing, audit event export (syslog/Kinesis), external KMS hooks, rollout gating & canary for private control plane. Milestone 2 (packaging v1 by Q4 start): deterministic installer artifacts (RPM/DEB + manifest), offline license/key injection, basic upgrade script.

Sam: Sounds good. Control-plane first reduces enterprise objections and unlocks more customers.

Lisa: For packaging v1, recommend strict scope: deterministic tarball + supported OS matrix, no custom driver support. Offer paid PS for integrations.

Mike: PharmaCorp needs full air-gap. Can we add a small spike in Milestone 1 for image export + checksum signing? Keep heavy offline installer work in Milestone 2.

Anya: Agree. Add a 2-week spike for air-gap image export & signed manifests in Milestone 1.

Nina: We need measurable gating criteria tied to OKRs. Suggested control-plane gating checklist: 1) 3 customer pilots signed MOUs, 2) Audit delivery validated for 2 customers, 3) KMS integration tested in one cloud, 4) HA failover tested (RTO < 2m).

Lisa: Who owns HA failover tests? Eng-infra + eng-sre pairing required.

Mike: I'll coordinate with eng-sre and schedule a staging runbook test.

Andrew: Resource ask: Milestone 1 needs 1 senior infra engineer + 0.5 PM for 3 months. Milestone 2 needs 1 release engineer + 0.5 eng for 3 months. Product can backfill PM with contractor if needed.

Sam: Approve sequencing and headcount trade: give infra headcount now, packaging later. Product to prep SOW for paid packaging engagement.

Anya: Risk: deprioritizing packaging may push PharmaCorp to competitor. Mitigation = paid engineering engagement + early access docs.

Lisa: PS estimate: 3-4 weeks of dedicated eng + SOW + support add-on.

Nina: Decision time — sequence control-plane first, packaging later. Vote: Anya ✅, Sam ✅, Mike ✅, Lisa ✅, Andrew ✅, Nina ✅.

Deploy-bot: action logged — ticket PRIV-422 created: "Sequence Private deploy: control-plane first, packaging follow-up" (owner: Andrew).

Anya: I'll update roadmap doc, add gating checklist to OKR tracker, and escalate headcount req to exec for sign-off. Will follow up with PharmaCorp offer for PS engagement.
